scope: Read-only recovery of an existing used engineering sequence selection after browser interruption; no server authorization changes.
riskAnalysis: Recovery may select only a validated owner-scoped existing open sequence with closed authority and conservative headroom; fresh release enrollment and one-time approval remain mandatory.

threatModel.assets: Existing owner selection, immutable history, task/release isolation and spending authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Server validates full owner/cohort/hash history. Redacted UI validates bounded references and double-readback stability; it cannot grant authority.
threatModel.abuseCases: Recover consumed approvals, choose foreign or stale sequence, overwrite uncertain cache, treat current release as enrolled, malformed history or active workers.
threatModel.mitigations: Two unchanged authenticated snapshots, same owner/workspace/runtime fence, empty caches, valid bounded history and revoked/closed references; save latest already enrolled runtime only.

rollback: Revert UI recovery extension and lock on feature branch; preserve all original sequence, configuration, tasks, grants, receipts and accounting.

defects.rootCause: Existing selection recovery explicitly required zero attempts and one enrollment, preventing recovery of a valid used open sequence after browser interruption.
defects.detectionGap: Prior recovery fixtures covered only pristine sequence and malformed attempted records.
defects.regression: Four consumed attempts and five valid enrollments recover through two GETs; 19 new adversaries and previous race/ownership/cache denial tests remain.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use realistic interrupted used-sequence readback; distinguish local selection from server enrollment or grants.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing UI selection recovery only; no gateway, journal, controller or financial policy changes.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No packages, secrets, infrastructure or provider permissions added.
proactiveReview.threats: Forged history references, stale runtime, ambiguous sequence, resurrected grants and cache overwrite.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing or changed authority/history fails closed without storage or server mutation.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Used-chain ordinals/links/duplicates, missing closed workflow or revoked approval, changed second readback, insufficient budget, foreign owner/workspace and cache races.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Work QA156/156 and Auditor140/140 approved; incidental encoding defect caught and corrected before freeze.
proactiveReview.recovery: Latest previously enrolled runtime saved only as local selection; current successor still requires exact reviewed release enrollment, fresh task and one-time approval.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused tests passed. Exact hosted STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL/Jekyll/Browser qualification required before paid continuation.
